records.title: Research on a Multidimensional Evaluation Algorithm for Primary and Secondary School Teachers' Teaching Quality Based on MoE and Graph Neural Networks
records.reason: MoE/GNN is used for school-teacher quality scoring, not LLM routing/inference.

records.title: Reliable Text-to-SQL in Resource-Constrained Settings with Small LLMs via Iterative Retry Workflows
records.reason: Small-model Text-to-SQL retries improve reliability by making additional inference calls; no cost reduction is shown. Linked to Q8BERT, so retained for review.

records.title: An Efficient HLS-Based Hardware Accelerator with Resource Optimization for Transformer Models
records.reason: HLS FPGA Transformer reuses attention/Add-Norm blocks and applies low precision; abstract claims lower BRAM/LUT/FF and power. Direct FTRANS accelerator lineage.

records.title: Self-Attention Gated Linear Recurrent Units for Sequential Recommendation
records.reason: Self-attention/LRU sequential recommendation targets recommendation accuracy, not language-model inference.

records.title: SF-QC: Explore the Selection Bias of Large Language Models in Zero-Shot Out-of-Distribution Intent Detection
records.reason: SF-QC adjusts intent ordering and adds query-confirmation for LLM OOD detection; it improves task metrics but includes deeper validation. Linked to MiniLMv2.
